- Working hours from 17:30 to 02:00 hours.

Build from the ground up in a new, automated warehouse environment and, as a Supervisor, provide direction across people, processes, and performance. Wie zoeken we? As a Supervisor, you combine strong leadership with a sharp eye for processes and results. You know how to motivate a team, hold people accountable, and keep a close eye on KPIs at the same time. You feel comfortable in a logistics environment where systems, data, and automation play an important role. For this position, we are looking for a Supervisor with experience in a warehouse environment and proven leadership responsibility. You do not need to have worked as a Supervisor for many years. An experienced Assistant Supervisor who is ready to take the next step is also welcome to apply. MBO+/HBO level of working and thinking At least 1 year of experience as a Supervisor, or several years of experience as an Assistant Supervisor with leadership responsibility Experience in a logistics or warehouse environment Experience working with complex systems, such as SAP, ERP, or WMS Good command of the English language Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule An analytical and results-oriented approach to work A coaching and collaborative leadership style Wat bieden wij je? As a Supervisor, you will have the opportunity to help build a new warehouse operation from the ground up. You will work in a professional and international environment where automation, development, and continuous process improvement are at the heart of the operation. Your own professional development is also given plenty of attention. A gross monthly salary of €2,560 to €4,164 based on a 40-hour workweek, depending on your experience A contract directly with the employer 19% shift allowance for hours worked between 7:00 PM and midnight 25 vacation days, with the option to purchase up to one additional week of leave, plus 3 additional non-sick days A company laptop and phone, also available for private use An attractive pension scheme

Discount on a gym membership, a bicycle scheme, informal activities, and team events Functieomschrijving As a Supervisor, you are responsible for managing and optimizing one of the logistics departments. You ensure that daily operations run smoothly, KPIs are achieved, and employees know exactly what is expected of them. You report directly to the Warehouse Manager. Every day, you work closely with both your team and the operation. You monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and make adjustments where needed. At the same time, you look ahead: where can processes be made smarter, faster, or more efficient? Managing, supporting, and coaching the team Monitoring and adjusting KPIs related to productivity, quality, and planning Leading daily start-up meetings and setting clear priorities Coordinating workforce planning with the Workforce team Identifying and implementing process improvements Working with automated systems within the warehouse environment Encouraging ownership and professional development within the team You work in a two-shift schedule, with early and late shifts on weekdays. You will receive an additional shift allowance for working these hours. Where will you work? As a Supervisor, you will join an international logistics organization specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. At the Lelystad location, a modern warehouse environment is being developed, with automation and technology playing a key role. The site is part of a larger international organization with thousands of employees and locations worldwide. Within this new operation, logistics, data, and automated processes come together. This makes it an exciting environment for a Supervisor who likes to look beyond the day-to-day planning. You will also have the opportunity to help build the operation from the ground up. Together with your colleagues, you will develop efficient ways of working, build strong teams, and create a warehouse operation that is ready for further growth.
